plugins/agent-guard/codex-skills/setup-a.description: Diagnose, install, and verify Agent Guard's plugin-local binary, jq and gitleaks dependencies, the active host integration, and live hook protection. Use when Agent Guard reports degraded protection, a SessionStart warning asks for setup, plugin hooks fail or appear bypassed, or a user asks to finish or repair Agent Guard installation.

plugins/agent-guard/codex-skills/setup-s.description: Install or refresh Agent Guard's plugin-local shell integration. Use when the user explicitly asks to enable or update shell command masking, or when a shell-integration warning directs them to rerun setup-shell.
